mapper.update: UPDATE admin_user SET password = #{credential}, password_change_required = FALSE, credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND credential_version = #{version} AND status = 1

UPDATE admin_user SET password = initial_password, password_change_required = TRUE, credential_version = credential_version + 1, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND credential_version = #{version} AND initial_password IS NOT NULL AND initial_password != ''
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, phone, password, initial_password, password_change_required, credential_version, user_role, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_user WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, username, phone, password, initial_password, password_change_required, credential_version, user_role, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_user WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, username, phone, password, initial_password, password_change_required, credential_version, user_role, status, create_time, update_time FROM admin_user ORDER BY create_time DESC
